program.section_heading: AMERICAN SIGN LANGUAGE STUDIES Associate of Arts Degree (STATE CODE 36785)
program.ge_pattern: Cal-GETC (34 units) or LACCD GE (21 units)
outcomes: Communicate clearly and effectively in ASL, expressing and recognizing specific manual and non-manual language elements.

Produce college-level American Sign Language and English texts demonstrating knowledge of, and critical inquiry into, key concepts or issues in American Sign Language, the Deaf Community, and Deaf Culture.
Share critical insight into the nature of the diverse Deaf community, its language and culture through a social justice orientation.
Demonstrate good citizenship and teamwork through respect, tolerance and cultural awareness of Deaf Culture.
Employ video technology for self- and peer-feedback for ongoing skills development, assessment, and communication.
Have the skills to self-assess and professionally develop for life-long learning.
